strings.speaking.no_prompts: Tell me about your day in three sentences.

strings.tips.say_more: Say more next time - aim for three or four full sentences.
strings.tips.fillers: You used {0} filler words. Pause silently instead of saying um.
strings.tips.connectives: Join your ideas with because, so and although to sound less like a list.
strings.tips.repetition: You repeated a lot of words. Try a synonym for the word you used most.
strings.tips.overused: Swap very and good for stronger words like extremely or excellent.
strings.tips.slow: Your pace was slow. Read a sentence aloud twice, then say it without looking.
strings.tips.fast: You spoke very fast. Slowing down will make you easier to understand.
strings.tips.strong: Strong answer. Next time add one detail nobody would expect.
strings.translation.empty: Give it a try - even a partial answer helps.
strings.translation.excellent: Exactly how a native speaker would say it.
strings.translation.close: Very close. The natural version is slightly tighter.
strings.translation.drifting: The meaning is there, but the structure drifts. Compare word by word.
strings.translation.wrong: Not quite. Read the natural version aloud twice, then try again.
